The video uses whiteboard-style graphics and brand cards in the upper visual zone to illustrate the acquisition.

The video discusses the acquisition of the AI developer brand Cursor by SpaceX AI, explaining that it will be phased out and absorbed into SpaceX AI and Grok. The speaker presents this information using whiteboard-style graphics and text labels while talking to the camera.

This final segment of the short shows a flag graphic with the word sunset, followed by SpaceX and a placeholder icon for Grok, before transitioning to the creator's outro handle card. The speaker concludes the video by encouraging viewers to follow for daily AI news and tutorials.
